name: retailer-system-dropshipping
description: Fullstack Retailer Dropshipping Automation System (Shopify & CJ/Zendrop Integration)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT,WORKER" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run worker --prefix server"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT,WORKER" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client" "npm run worker --prefix server"
